Title: What Does Each Jamboree Buddy Do In Super Mario Party Jamboree?
URL: https://www.thegamer.com/super-mario-party-jamboree-buddy-allies-abilities-minigames-perks/
Published: 2024-10-23T15:30:17.000Z
Author: Gabrielle Castania
Highlights:
To get a buddy in Super Mario Party Jamboree, you’ll need to wait until someone shows up on the game board, which is shown at the beginning of the turn on which it happens. This will be a random character that spawns someplace on your map every few turns, and when this happens, you have three turns to get to their location before they disappear for the rest of the game.
...
Once you reach a buddy in Super Mario Party Jamboree, don’t think you get that friend just because you got there first, though! When one player reaches where the buddy is on the game board, everyone will need to compete in a four-player minigame to earn the right to have said buddy. Every character in Super Mario Party Jamboree has a unique minigame you’ll need to win to claim them as your board partner.
...
When the minigame ends, the buddy goes with whoever won their minigame, no matter who first triggered said game. The buddy remains on the board following that character for three turns, disappearing at the beginning of the fourth turn after their minigame. This count of three turns begins when the buddy minigame is played, not when the buddy first appears on the game map.
...

Title: How does Luigi affect your chance of rolling bigger numbers?
URL: https://gaming.stackexchange.com/questions/410058/how-does-luigi-affect-your-chance-of-rolling-bigger-numbers
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
When you get Luigi as a buddy in Super Mario Party Jamboree, the game says his ability is:

When you hit a dice you'll have an easier time rolling bigger numbers.

How exactly does Luigi's ability work when you roll a dice? Is it like a weighted dice? If so, how much more likely are you to roll higher numbers?
...
After rolling all your dice on your turn Luigi will attempt to nudge the dice. If he succeeds the value of the dice is set to 10, else it stays the same as before.
If you rolled two or three dice in your turn and he succeeds all dice will change to a 10. You will thus also get the doubles / triples bonus coins.
The specific chance of the ability triggering is unclear but it seems to be around 33%.
